full.description: This is a low-power histological micrograph showing a cross-section of the colon. The tissue exhibits extensive mucosal inflammation, ulceration, and architectural distortion of the crypts. These prominent chronic inflammatory changes, along with mucosal loss and submucosal edema, are characteristic features of chronic ulcerative colitis.

random.description: This is a low-power photomicrograph of an oral mucosal lesion, most likely representing a residual cyst. The histological section shows a cystic cavity lined by stratified squamous epithelium supported by a fibrous connective tissue wall. Chronic inflammatory cell infiltration is typically present within the fibrous capsule. The specimen exhibits characteristic features of an odontogenic cyst.
